test_case_name: Accept All Cookies on Privacy Policy Page

intents.intent: Click 'Acconsento' on the privacy policy page to accept all cookies
And then check that all cookies are accepted and the cookie banner is dismissed

test_case_name: Open Cookie Options on Privacy Policy Page

intents.intent: Click 'Più opzioni' on the privacy policy page to view cookie options
And then check that the cookie options or cookie policy page is displayed

test_case_name: Close Cookie Banner on Privacy Policy Page

intents.intent: Click the button with id 'cookie-chiudi' on the privacy policy page to close the cookie banner
And then check that the cookie banner is no longer visible
